newsitem.title: USA: Harrah's Entertainment Inc cuts Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Harrah's Entertainment Inc cuts Q4 loss.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1996 Q4 operating profit of $0.22 per share, prior to charges including project writedowns and reserves for contingent liabilities totalling $0.27 per share.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1996 year results before project write-downs and reserves for contingent liabilities total $1.22 a share.
Q4 1995 includes pre-tax writeoffs of $93.3 million related to joint ventures, primarily in New Orleans.
1995 year results reflect earnings per share of $0.21 for hotel operations and a charge of $0.21 per share for transaction costs of the spinoff of the hotel operations.
1996 project reorganization costs totaled $3.4 million and $14.6 million in Q4 and the year, respectively.
1996 Q4 project write downs and reserves totaled $50 million.
